reviews.title: Cautiously Optimistic

I have not had the opportunity to check out the various articles, but I will as time permits. I just received some bad news regarding blood work that I completed on 21 August 2026. I will check back in 90 days and update my progress. Thank you for this app.

reviews.title: No LR what I envisioned
reviews.text: Tracked my food, my weight, my water intake. Stayed under 20 carbs for 4 weeks and didn’t see any weight difference in fact I’m heavier now than when I started. I practice intermittent fasting 20:4. I follow a pretty strict Keto diet and I exercise mildly, have a bad ankle. The app kept reminding me to post my dinner and weight when I had already posted. So not sure what the app did for me.
